_note: Manual semantic audit of the deterministic audit sample (python -m masteredge audit-sample). Each verdict is keyed to the exact value audited (audit_key); if the value changes the verdict no longer applies and the item returns to PENDING. 'retract_evidence_ids' is the audited remediation step: those evidence records are kept but excluded from facts.
auditor: Claude (independent manual review against stored source pages fetched from the live official site)
method: For each sampled fact: open the cited source page snapshot, read the surrounding context, and judge whether the value is a correct reading of what the source states (not only that the text exists).
